transcript: During upreach phase, we flight, we flew as we planned in the first step, but few minutes after we have the braking system function on the display. So we advise that our system is inoperative and we only, we can only use the landing distance upper 3,100. So the ATC inform us another airport. So on the divert, we, we use the alternate system and the function, the function is come back and there's no smoke. And we, we continue to just approach, just approach, just airport again. So we can land as we planned.
